how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for TANUVAS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 05-10-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

Master's degree in the concerned / relevant discipline with a minimum of 55% marks. Preference for NET qualified candidates (ASRB / ICAR / UGC / CSIR or SLET / SET).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for TANUVAS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 05-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TANUVAS Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 05-10-2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Assistant Professor posts will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 57,700/-. This is a fixed consolidated salary for the contractual period.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the Assistant Professor role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess recognized veterinary qualifications as per the IVC Act 1984, a B.V.Sc & A.H or B.V.Sc with at least 60% marks, and a Master's degree in the concerned discipline with a minimum of 55% marks.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Assistant Professor positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Professor posts will primarily involve an interview and document verification. Candidates who perform well in the interview and have their documents in order will be considered.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies for the Assistant Professor posts announced by TANUVAS. These vacancies are distributed across various specializations within veterinary sciences.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application for the TANUVAS Assistant Professor recruitment must be submitted via email. Candidates need to prepare their application and send it to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Assistant Professor positions is scheduled to be held on 09-10-2026. Candidates are advised to be present on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q9. Does TANUVAS offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify details regarding age relaxation. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any information related to age limits and relaxations.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to read the PDF thoroughly before applying.
